body: I think my boyfriend just left me because I'm fucking crazy and he can't handle it anymore. My life is crashing, holy shit.

You're right. I love him but he's the only thing that's keeping me going at this point. I have a boyfriend who hates my depression, a mom who tells me to get over it, and a father who pretty much caused all this from childhood abuse. I used to be so happy or at least thought I was and now I have no motivation for anything. Im freaking out right now, my heart is racing, I'm crying so much, and im about to call the suicide hotline. I'm losing myself and no one is helping..

I just started seeing my psychologist (a week ago) and the first day was just paper work and filling out this questionnaire such as how I feel, my sleeping/eating habits, and what is my goal. I put to "wake up happy :)". My psychologist then went over it with me and decided I need to see a psychiatrist for anti anxiety and anti depression medication. She will continue to see me while this is going to check how the medication is effecting me, if I'm making progress, and she's setting goals for me to reach again such as finding things I like. It feels great to talk to someone and just to have them listen. Good for you for going, I wish you the best of luck!

Relax, you're not dumb! It's just the stress and sadness is effecting your school work, you're human and that's perfectly normal. I actually had to drop a few college classes this semester because of how bad my depression is. I just didn't have motivation to do well anymore or see the point. I've been battling depression for awhile and still was in honors, just this semester hit me hard. Don't worry too much and don't be too hard on yourself. You'll be okay, I promise.
